notes: `A` (selector `['src', 'liba']`) and `B` (selector `['src', 'libb']`) are both proven supersets of current `C` (selector `['src/mod']`), but neither proves a superset over the other -- the shared `'src'` token makes their pairwise relation `'unknown'` (overlap without containment either way), so neither demotes the other and both stay maximal. `baseline.superset_candidates` MUST disclose 2 (spec §5.2 normative, no equal-class or overlap-class dedupe). The more recent `B` wins the tie-break; the `selector-subset` event's `from: 'libb src'` is the direct observational proof of which selector was disclosed as baseline (the vitest recorder alphabetically sorts `invocation.selector` at record time -- src/adapters/vitest/recorder.ts -- so `B`'s recorded selector is `['libb', 'src']`, not the `run` step's argument order). `libb/b.test.ts` (red) is outside `C`'s narrower selector and is disclosed via `transitions.out_of_scope`.
